_meta.name: Curated Clinical Formulary
_meta.scope: Hackathon MVP. Common self-limiting primary-care presentations only.
_meta.disclaimer: This formulary grounds AI DRAFT generation only. It is never authorization to prescribe. Every entry requires doctor review before reaching a patient.
_meta.review_status: Curated for demonstration. NOT clinically validated for real patient use.

protocols.presentation: Fever with generalized body ache, chills, malaise and headache. No localizing or red-flag features.

medications.name: Paracetamol (Acetaminophen)
medications.instructions: Take with water after food. Do not exceed 4,000 mg in 24 hours.

protocols.instructions: Maintain oral hydration with water and ORS. Avoid heavy physical exertion. Seek doctor care if fever exceeds 102 F, persists beyond 4 days, or new symptoms appear.
escalate_if: fever in an infant under 3 months

protocols.presentation: Runny nose, sneezing, mild sore throat and non-productive cough without fever or respiratory distress.

medications.name: Cetirizine Hydrochloride
medications.instructions: May cause drowsiness. Avoid driving or operating machinery after taking.

medications.name: Warm Saline Gargle and Steam Inhalation
medications.instructions: Inhale warm steam for 5-10 minutes and gargle with warm salt water.

protocols.instructions: Drink warm liquids and rest. Monitor for breathing difficulty, chest tightness or high fever.

protocols.condition: Gastro-oesophageal reflux disease without oesophagitis / Dyspepsia
protocols.presentation: Burning retrosternal or epigastric discomfort, sour eructation, worse after meals or lying flat.

medications.name: Pantoprazole
medications.instructions: Take 30 minutes before breakfast on an empty stomach with plain water.

medications.name: Antacid Oral Gel (Magaldrate with Simethicone)
medications.instructions: Shake well before use. Take 1-2 teaspoons when experiencing acid burn.

protocols.instructions: Avoid spicy, oily and fried food. Eat small frequent meals. Do not lie down for 2 hours after eating. Elevate the head of the bed.
escalate_if: chest pain radiating to arm or jaw

protocols.presentation: Bilateral, band-like, pressing head pain of mild to moderate intensity without neurological deficit.

medications.name: Paracetamol
medications.instructions: Take after light food with water. Maintain hydration.

protocols.instructions: Ensure adequate rest and hydration of 2-3 litres per day. Reduce screen exposure and take regular breaks.
escalate_if: headache with fever and neck stiffness
headache with weakness or slurred speech

protocols.presentation: Loose stools without blood, without high fever and without signs of significant dehydration.

medications.name: Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS)
medications.instructions: Dissolve one sachet completely in 1 litre of clean drinking water. Drink after every loose motion.

medications.name: Probiotic Spores (Bacillus clausii)
medications.instructions: Drink directly or dilute in a small amount of water.

protocols.instructions: Eat a light bland diet such as banana, rice and yoghurt. Avoid milk, greasy and fried food. Watch for signs of dehydration.

protocols.presentation: Recurrent sneezing, itchy watery eyes and clear nasal discharge, often seasonal or exposure related.

medications.name: Levocetirizine
medications.instructions: Take at night. May cause mild drowsiness.

protocols.instructions: Identify and avoid the trigger where possible. Use a mask in dusty environments. Rinse nasal passages with saline.
